title: finding(plugin-charts): `xAxis.position` is declared, documented ("the side of the chart the axis belongs to") and kept by the normaliser, but no `<XAxis>` reads it: `position: 'top'` draws the axis at the bottom
body:
Filing-gate category: ② a declared capability the runtime does not honour (class b): the spec declares the key, objectui declares it by reference, the docs teach it, and the renderer ignores it on the x axis. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10516 dev report (PR objectui#10571, merged `a5060016`). The contract reviewer confirmed it at source; recorded on ACCEPT `5830377326`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Fact (read by the seat on `origin/main` at `a50600166`, which includes PR objectui#10571)

- **Declared.** `ChartSchema.xAxis` takes `@objectstack/spec`'s `ChartAxisSchema` by reference (objectui#7690 / PR objectui#10511), and `position` is one of its nine keys (`left | right | top | bottom`).
- **Kept.** Since PR objectui#10571, `normalizeChartSchema` keeps the x-axis object whenever it carries any declared key besides `field`, `position` included (`normalizeChartSchema.ts:~483`).
- **Documented.** `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx:~241`: "`position` … The side of the chart the axis belongs to." It is not scoped to the y axes.
- **Not read.** `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`:
  - `xAxisCommonProps` (~:1680–1693) reads `xAxisSpec.title`, and nothing else from the spec;
  - no `<XAxis>` (~:2181, ~:2288, ~:2387, ~:2399) is given an `orientation`;
  - the only `position` reads are on the y side: `primaryY?.position === 'right'` (~:1509, ~:2691).

⇒ `xAxis: { field: 'month', position: 'top' }` validates and survives normalisation, and the axis still draws at the bottom. PR objectui#10571's changeset already says the inert site moved from the normaliser to the renderer.

Recorded with it, and consistent with the docs today: `min` / `max` / `stepSize` / `logarithmic` also survive onto CATEGORY x axes (bar, line, area), which read only `format` / `title` / `showGridLines`. The docs scope those four to "a numeric axis … and the x axis of a `scatter` chart", so that part is honest. It is noted here only so the claiming seat does not re-discover it.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Per "spec declaration > implementation > docs": a declared key that is not honoured is an implementation gap, to be implemented or retired, ⛔ not narrowed at the consumer.
- **Implement:** map `xAxis.position` `top` / `bottom` to recharts `orientation` on each `<XAxis>` (the horizontal-bar arm swaps axes, so its mapping needs a decision). `left` / `right` on an x axis has no meaning in a vertical chart and needs a stated reading.
- **Or narrow the docs row** to the y axes, with a named refusal of `position` on `xAxis`. That moves an accept set: `Clause-②: yes`.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18T15:37Z):
- `xAxis` within 40 characters of `position` ⇒ 1 hit, PR objectui#10571 (the origin);
- `orientation` near `XAxis|x axis` ⇒ 0.

Dedupe words: `xAxis position top ignored` · `x axis position inert orientation` · `chart axis position top bottom XAxis`
